sanskrit_verse:
जाता ये त्वनियुक्तायामेकेन बहुभिस्तथा।
अरिक्थभाजस्ते सर्वे बीजिनामेव ते सुताः॥
transliteration: jātā ye tvaniyuktāyām ekena bahubhis tathā | arikthabhājas te sarve bījinām eva te sutāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those born from unregulated unions—whether by one man with many women, or one woman with many men—are inheritors of conflict and division; they are truly the sons of seeds sown in discord.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from regulated union sanctioned by Dharma
Causation arises from alignment with conscious intention, not biological fact alone
Capacity-based responsibility extends to progenitors who act without dharmic regulation
Restoration logic demands reintegration through purified lineage structures
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of origin and rectification of energetic fragmentation
executable_legal_axioms: IF union occurs outside dharmically ordained regulation THEN offspring classified under provisional status until integration process completed
IF individual claims inheritance rights from unregulated parentage THEN mandatory completion of consciousness alignment protocol before recognition
IF societal disruption traced to unregulated generational lineage THEN initiate family-tree restorative reintegration sequence
IF claimant demonstrates full capacity restoration AND integrity reintegration THEN elevate status to equal inheritance eligibility
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning inheritance, legitimacy, or custodial authority arising from non-dharmic unions, the Supreme Court shall assess not merely legal documentation but the ontological integrity of the lineage. Responsibility lies with those capable of initiating restoration, prioritizing consciousness coherence over biological assertion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unregulated actions generate fragmented outcomes. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how such fragmentation manifests across generations. Proportional responsibility rests with those possessing awareness and capacity to restore order. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction arises through conscious realignment, not infliction of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Lineage Clarification Process to establish energetic continuity
Assign Completion Rituals to harmonize ancestral dissonance
Activate Conscious Consent Protocols for all involved parties
Execute Integrity Reintegration Sequence to dissolve karmic echoes of unregulated conception
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Juridical Authority: Dharma is restored through conscious alignment, not punitive enforcement. All laws derive their validity from this Source. Reality responds only to awakened responsibility. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
